title: Market, Katsuō-ji, A5 wagyu, Tenjinbashi, Umeda at night

items.text: Yotsubashi Line Tamade → Daikokuchō, exit 1, 3 min walk.
Fish breakfast: seafood bowl or market sushi. Cash only; many stalls close by ~11:00.
Daikokuchō → Midōsuji Line to Minoh-Kayano (check the train goes all the way), then Hankyu Bus 30 from stop No. 8 (~25 min, 2–3/h, IC or exact cash). Arrive ~10:45.
Daruma-filled mountain temple, autumn colour. 8:00–17:00 (last entry 16:30), ¥500 (verify).
Bus back → Minoh-Kayano → Midōsuji Line to Umeda, arriving ~13:20.
A5 wagyu lunch (not Kobe): pick one of the three below on the day. If late: light lunch instead, and the beef moves to Sat 21.
Yakiniku: thin slices you grill yourselves. ~¥6,000–8,000 pp. Lunch last order 14:00, so only if on time.
Teppanyaki: thick steak cooked by the chef; choose cut and grams. A5 lean 100 g ¥8,580. Last order 15:00. Not the Sakura Beef set (not A5).
Teppanyaki steak. Ask for A5 Kuroge wagyu, not Kobe; non-Kobe price not found. Lunch until 15:00.
Tanimachi Line Higashi-Umeda → Minami-morimachi, then 5 min walk.
Coffee to go (closes ~18:00). Osaka Tenmangū is next door (9:00–17:00): 📿 stamp there.
Walk north along the arcade; snacks.
Pre-war lanes; many cafés close early. Then walk to Umeda Sky (~15 min).
Dinner in Fukushima. Suggestion for chicken skin: O26a Ichiya.
Fukushima → Tamade (walk to Nishi-Umeda, Yotsubashi Line).
